titles.romaji: Ryou Seibai!: Gakuen Bishoujo Seisai Hiroku
titles.native: 凌成敗! ~学園美少女制裁秘録~

description:
Based on the erotic game by Tinker Bell.

An elite Academy that specializes in the highest person's position and is free to do anything to a lowly person. In essence, many students feel arrogant because of the position above.

(Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)
